1292-3117-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.

When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

728-2393-2464-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2393-2464-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.

Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Clever Impersonator.

Repeat each turn.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Showdown of the Skalds trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1661-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

1506-4831-5166.description:
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it, dealing damage to any target.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

If needed, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

687-3213-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Boromir is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Boromir is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-3213-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Boromir by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Boromir from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Boromir enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Boromir.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Boromir and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Boromir by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Boromir from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-3213-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

1170-4377-6333.notablePrerequisites:

1170-4377-6333.description:

When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

5104-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 3 if the additional creature is not a creature token, or 2 otherwise.
5104-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, if it was a token, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4826-5413-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.

Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.

Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

Treasury Thrull triggers, returning a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {U}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Seat of the Synod ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Mystical Tutor, putting Beacon of Tomorrows on top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Draw Beacon of Tomorrows from the top of your library.
Repeat.

1193-1721-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {8}{R}{R}.
1193-1721-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Codex Shredder.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target.
Activate the token copy of Codex Shredder by paying {5}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {8}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.

1283-3525-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.
